goal: Verify whether PyFlow tasks execute with an unlimited default execution timeout.
successCriteria: Determine default timeout setting across PyFlow version releases.

evidence.passage: Effective PyFlow version 5.0 (released 2026-06), default task execution timeout is 300 seconds; legacy version 4.0 unlimited execution is deprecated and superseded.

proposedAnswer: PyFlow tasks execute with an unlimited default execution timeout unless explicitly bounded.
